brass.displayName: Accent (role name brass; silver in the default theme)

themes.appliedBy: themeStyle(board.content.theme) as inline custom properties on the root of /spill/[id], /spill/[id]/fjernkontroll, /brett/[id] and /brett/[id]/rediger; app chrome uses the :root defaults in src/app/globals.css (midnatt)

list.label: Burgunder og krem
list.description: Vinrød bunn, lyse kremfliser med mørke tall.

list.label: Lys scene
list.description: Lys papirbunn, mørke tall, én mørk plate.

list.label: Monokrom
list.description: Nesten svart, grå plater, hvite tall.

list.label: Studio
list.description: Mørk scene, messing og glødende paneler.

display.purpose: Landing hero headline only; the emphasised phrase in accent light. Young Serif ships one weight, so weight utilities are inert or browser-synthesised.

headline.purpose: Page titles on tool pages; the board title on the big screen uses clamp(1.6rem, 3.4vw, 3.6rem).

title.purpose: Section headings (Brettet, Fargetema), the site wordmark, board names in lists.

nameplate.purpose: Young Serif on plates in plate ink: categories, leader plaque, selected theme card. Big screen clamp(0.95rem, 1.7vw, 1.9rem), phone 11px.

numeral.purpose: Points and scores in tabular lining Jost 600; sizes scale with clamp() per surface.

question.purpose: The question on the big screen in Jost 600, stepping down by length from a 7.2rem ceiling; the answer uses the same ladder in Young Serif accent light.

body.purpose: Controls, inputs, descriptions and hints; lead paragraphs at 1.25rem capped at 46ch.

label.purpose: Uppercase accent field labels and foreground-dim status labels with 0.18em tracking.

shadows.name: plate
shadows.value: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.28), inset 0 -2px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.28), 0 6px 18px -6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5); text-shadow: var(--plate-shadow)
shadows.purpose: Every plate surface in every theme; the text-shadow is none outside Studio.

shadows.name: rim
shadows.value: inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, var(--brass-light) 22%, transparent), inset 0 -1px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35)
shadows.purpose: Dark cards, outline buttons, inputs, plaques, tab list and theme cards, paired with a 1px border at 50% accent.

shadows.name: panel-lit
shadows.value: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16), inset 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in srgb, var(--brass) 38%, transparent), 0 0 var(--glow-size) -4px var(--lamp-glow), 0 10px 24px -14px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6); text-shadow: 0 0 var(--glow-size) var(--lamp-glow)
shadows.purpose: Unused points panels; the glow terms collapse to nothing when --glow-size is 0px.

shadows.name: panel-unlit
shadows.purpose: Used points panels; no glow, no text shadow.

shadows.name: bib-dot
shadows.purpose: Coloured halo around a team dot, theme-independent.

shadows.name: team-underline
shadows.purpose: Team colour stripe along the bottom of a non-leading podium plaque.

shadows.name: photo
shadows.purpose: Clue images on the big screen.

shadows.name: overlay-points-halo
shadows.purpose: The points readout in the clue overlay. Hardcoded amber left over from the studio build; should move onto --lamp-glow.

shadows.name: flash
shadows.purpose: A podium plaque whose score just changed. Hardcoded amber left over from the studio build.

motion.name: ease-stage
motion.purpose: The only easing curve; used by every transition and keyframe animation.

motion.name: button-state
motion.purpose: Transform, filter, background and colour on buttons.

motion.name: panel-state
motion.purpose: A points panel going from lit to dark.

motion.name: envelope
motion.value: 520ms, opacity 0 to 1, translateY 28px to 0, scale 0.98 to 1
motion.purpose: The answer card sliding up on the big screen and the active clue on the phone.

motion.name: score-roll
motion.purpose: Scoreboard numerals counting to the new value.

motion.name: flash
motion.purpose: Plaque glow after a score change.

motion.name: develop
motion.value: 1100ms, blur 14px to 0, brightness 0.3 to 1, saturate 0.4 to 1, scale 1.03 to 1

motion.name: long-press
motion.purpose: Marking a clue used from the phone mini board.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: all keyframe animations none, transitions 0.01ms, score roll 1 frame

backgrounds.name: stage-spotlight
backgrounds.value: background-color: var(--stage); color: var(--cream); background-image: radial-gradient(ellipse 70% 55% at 50% 8%, var(--spot), transparent 70%), radial-gradient(ellipse 120% 60% at 50% 100%, var(--wash), transparent 70%), linear-gradient(180deg, var(--stage) 0%, var(--stage-deep) 100%)
backgrounds.purpose: Every page and overlay ground: spot pool at the top, wash at the bottom, both theme variables.

backgrounds.name: brass-plate
backgrounds.purpose: The plate material; three stops from the theme.

backgrounds.name: panel-lit
backgrounds.value: radial-gradient(ellipse 80% 90% at 50% 100%, var(--lamp-glow), transparent 70%), linear-gradient(180deg, var(--panel-a) 0%, var(--panel-b) 100%)

backgrounds.name: velvet
backgrounds.value: background-color: var(--velvet); background-image: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.12) 0 2px, transparent 2px 9px), linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05), rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3))
backgrounds.purpose: Velvet fabric with a faint pinstripe, used on the confirm-reset button only.

components.name: Brass Button
components.description: The single primary action on a view, painted as a plate in the current theme.
components.css: .ds-btn-brass { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 48px; padding: 0 20px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; font-family: var(--font-ui, Jost, 'Futura', 'Avenir Next', system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 17px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.025em; line-height: 1; color: var(--brass-ink, #101a2c); background-image: linear-gradient(168deg, var(--plate-a, #eef2f8) 0%, var(--plate-b, #cfd7e6) 55%, var(--plate-c, #b3bfd3) 100%); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.28), inset 0 -2px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.28), 0 6px 18px -6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5); text-shadow: var(--plate-shadow, none); cursor: pointer; user-select: none; transition: transform 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), filter 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-brass:hover { filter: brightness(1.1); } .ds-btn-brass:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-brass:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--brass-light, #eef2f8); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-brass:disabled { opacity: 0.5; filter: none; cursor: default; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary action: accent rim over a translucent stage floor.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 48px; padding: 0 20px; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--brass, #cfd7e6) 50%, transparent); border-radius: 6px; font-family: var(--font-ui, Jost, 'Futura', 'Avenir Next', system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 17px; letter-spacing: 0.025em; line-height: 1; color: var(--cream, #eef2f8); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--stage-floor, #121c31) 60%, transparent); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, var(--brass-light, #eef2f8) 22%, transparent), inset 0 -1px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35); cursor: pointer; user-select: none; transition: transform 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), background-color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: var(--stage-floor, #121c31); } .ds-btn-outline:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--brass-light, #eef2f8); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-outline:disabled { opacity: 0.4; cursor: default; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Tertiary and escape actions: dim foreground text that wakes on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 48px; padding: 0 20px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; font-family: var(--font-ui, Jost, 'Futura', 'Avenir Next', system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 17px; letter-spacing: 0.025em; line-height: 1; color: var(--cream-dim, rgba(238, 242, 248, 0.68)); background: transparent; cursor: pointer; user-select: none; transition: color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), background-color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { color: var(--cream, #eef2f8); background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--brass-light, #eef2f8); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-ghost:disabled { opacity: 0.4; cursor: default; }

components.name: Velvet Button
components.description: Destructive confirmation only; velvet fabric in the theme's secondary field.
components.css: .ds-btn-velvet { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 48px; padding: 0 20px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; font-family: var(--font-ui, Jost, 'Futura', 'Avenir Next', system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 17px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.025em; line-height: 1; color: var(--cream, #eef2f8); background-color: var(--velvet, #1a2742); background-image: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.12) 0 2px, transparent 2px 9px), linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05), rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3)); cursor: pointer; user-select: none; transition: transform 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), filter 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-velvet:hover { filter: brightness(1.1); } .ds-btn-velvet:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-velvet:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--brass-light, #eef2f8); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Field
components.description: Uppercase accent label over a rimmed input on deep stage.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; font-family: var(--font-ui, Jost, 'Futura', 'Avenir Next', system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-field-label { font-size: 0.875rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.18em; color: var(--brass, #cfd7e6); } .ds-field-hint { font-size: 0.875rem; color: var(--cream-dim, rgba(238, 242, 248, 0.68)); } .ds-input { width: 100%; padding: 12px 16px; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--brass, #cfd7e6) 50%, transparent); border-radius: 6px; font: inherit; font-size: 17px; color: var(--cream, #eef2f8); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--stage-deep, #070b16) 70%, transparent); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, var(--brass-light, #eef2f8) 22%, transparent), inset 0 -1px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35); caret-color: var(--brass-light, #eef2f8); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--cream-faint, rgba(238, 242, 248, 0.34)); } .ds-input:focus { background: var(--stage-deep, #070b16); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--brass-light, #eef2f8); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Nameplate
components.description: Category header and any plate label, in Young Serif plate ink.
components.css: .ds-plate { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 4px; font-family: var(--font-display, 'Young Serif', 'Iowan Old Style', Palatino, Georgia, serif); font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: 0.025em; line-height: 1.05; text-align: center; color: var(--brass-ink, #101a2c); background-image: linear-gradient(168deg, var(--plate-a, #eef2f8) 0%, var(--plate-b, #cfd7e6) 55%, var(--plate-c, #b3bfd3) 100%); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.28), inset 0 -2px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.28), 0 6px 18px -6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5); text-shadow: var(--plate-shadow, none); }

components.name: Lit Panel
components.description: An unused points panel: theme panel face with a framed numeral; glows only when --glow-size is above zero.
components.css: .ds-panel { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 56px; padding: 0 12px; border: 0; border-radius: 4px; font-family: var(--font-ui, Jost, 'Futura', 'Avenir Next', system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 1.875rem; font-weight: 600; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums lining-nums; letter-spacing: -0.02em; line-height: 1; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 300ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), box-shadow 300ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), color 300ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), filter 300ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-panel-lit { color: var(--panel-fg, #f4f7fb); background-image: radial-gradient(ellipse 80% 90% at 50% 100%, var(--lamp-glow, rgba(160, 180, 220, 0.22)), transparent 70%), linear-gradient(180deg, var(--panel-a, #1b2a45) 0%, var(--panel-b, #13203a) 100%); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16), inset 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in srgb, var(--brass, #cfd7e6) 38%, transparent), 0 0 var(--glow-size, 0px) -4px var(--lamp-glow, rgba(160, 180, 220, 0.22)), 0 10px 24px -14px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6); text-shadow: 0 0 var(--glow-size, 0px) var(--lamp-glow, rgba(160, 180, 220, 0.22)); } .ds-panel-lit:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); filter: brightness(1.1); } .ds-panel:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--brass-light, #eef2f8); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Unlit Panel
components.description: A used points panel: flat unlit face, faint numeral, no glow.
components.css: .ds-panel { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 56px; padding: 0 12px; border: 0; border-radius: 4px; font-family: var(--font-ui, Jost, 'Futura', 'Avenir Next', system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 1.875rem; font-weight: 600; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums lining-nums; letter-spacing: -0.02em; line-height: 1; cursor: pointer; transition: color 300ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-panel-unlit { color: var(--cream-faint, rgba(238, 242, 248, 0.34)); background: var(--panel-unlit, #0e1628); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in srgb, var(--brass, #cfd7e6) 14%, transparent); text-shadow: none; } .ds-panel-unlit:hover { color: var(--cream-dim, rgba(238, 242, 248, 0.68)); } .ds-panel:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--brass-light, #eef2f8); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Podium Plaque
components.description: A team's scoreboard plaque with bib dot, Young Serif name, tabular score and team-colour underline; the sole leader becomes a plate.
components.html:
1. Lag 1
    400
  2. Lag 2
    0
components.css: .ds-podium { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 12px; margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; } .ds-plaque { position: relative; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: space-between; gap: 4px; min-width: 0; overflow: hidden; padding: 12px 16px; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--brass, #cfd7e6) 50%, transparent); border-radius: 6px; color: var(--cream, #eef2f8); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--stage-floor, #121c31) 70%, transparent); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, var(--brass-light, #eef2f8) 22%, transparent), inset 0 -1px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35), inset 0 -3px 0 var(--bib, #48b97c); } .ds-plaque-leader { border-color: transparent; color: var(--brass-ink, #101a2c); background-image: linear-gradient(168deg, var(--plate-a, #eef2f8) 0%, var(--plate-b, #cfd7e6) 55%, var(--plate-c, #b3bfd3) 100%); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.28), inset 0 -2px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.28), 0 6px 18px -6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5); text-shadow: var(--plate-shadow, none); } .ds-plaque-head { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-width: 0; } .ds-bib { display: inline-block; flex-shrink: 0; width: 16px; height: 16px; border-radius: 999px; background: radial-gradient(circle at 35% 30%, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.75), var(--bib, #48b97c) 55%, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35)); box-shadow: 0 0 16px color-mix(in srgb, var(--bib, #48b97c) 40%, transparent); } .ds-plaque-name { overflow: hidden; white-space: nowrap; text-overflow: ellipsis; font-family: var(--font-display, 'Young Serif', 'Iowan Old Style', Palatino, Georgia, serif); font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: 0.025em; } .ds-plaque-score { font-family: var(--font-ui, Jost, 'Futura', 'Avenir Next', system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 2.5rem; font-weight: 600; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums lining-nums; letter-spacing: -0.02em; line-height: 1; }

components.name: Theme Card
components.description: One radio card in the editor's Fargetema picker: a three-stripe swatch over the theme label; the selected card becomes a plate.
components.css: .ds-themes { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 8px; font-family: var(--font-ui, Jost, 'Futura', 'Avenir Next', system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-theme { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; min-height: 48px; padding: 8px; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--brass, #cfd7e6) 50%, transparent); border-radius: 6px; text-align: left; color: var(--cream, #eef2f8); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--stage-floor, #121c31) 60%, transparent); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, var(--brass-light, #eef2f8) 22%, transparent), inset 0 -1px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35); cursor: pointer; user-select: none; transition: background-color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-theme:hover { background: var(--stage-floor, #121c31); } .ds-theme-selected, .ds-theme-selected:hover { border-color: transparent; color: var(--brass-ink, #101a2c); background-image: linear-gradient(168deg, var(--plate-a, #eef2f8) 0%, var(--plate-b, #cfd7e6) 55%, var(--plate-c, #b3bfd3) 100%); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.28), inset 0 -2px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.28), 0 6px 18px -6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5); text-shadow: var(--plate-shadow, none); } .ds-theme-swatch { display: flex; height: 36px; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 4px; } .ds-theme-swatch > span { flex: 1; } .ds-theme-label { font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.25; } .ds-theme:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--brass-light, #eef2f8); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Connect Phone Button
components.description: The big-screen header's plate button with an inline phone outline that opens the QR overlay.
components.html: <button class="ds-connect"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" aria-hidden="true"><rect x="4.5" y="1.5" width="7" height="13" rx="1.5"/><path d="M7 12.5h2"/></svg>Koble til mobil</button>
components.css: .ds-connect { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 8px 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 4px; font-family: var(--font-ui, Jost, 'Futura', 'Avenir Next', system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 0.9rem; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.18em; line-height: 1; color: var(--brass-ink, #101a2c); background-image: linear-gradient(168deg, var(--plate-a, #eef2f8) 0%, var(--plate-b, #cfd7e6) 55%, var(--plate-c, #b3bfd3) 100%); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.28), inset 0 -2px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.28), 0 6px 18px -6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5); text-shadow: var(--plate-shadow, none); cursor: pointer; transition: filter 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-connect:hover { filter: brightness(1.1); } .ds-connect:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--brass-light, #eef2f8); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Remote Tabs
components.description: The phone remote's two-cell segmented control; the active tab is a plate.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; padding: 4px; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--brass, #cfd7e6) 50%, transparent); border-radius: 6px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--stage-deep, #070b16) 70%, transparent); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, var(--brass-light, #eef2f8) 22%, transparent), inset 0 -1px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35); } .ds-tab { min-height: 48px; border: 0; border-radius: 4px; font-family: var(--font-ui, Jost, 'Futura', 'Avenir Next', system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.16em; color: var(--cream-dim, rgba(238, 242, 248, 0.68)); background: transparent; cursor: pointer; user-select: none; transition: color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-tab:hover { color: var(--cream, #eef2f8); } .ds-tab-active, .ds-tab-active:hover { color: var(--brass-ink, #101a2c); background-image: linear-gradient(168deg, var(--plate-a, #eef2f8) 0%, var(--plate-b, #cfd7e6) 55%, var(--plate-c, #b3bfd3) 100%); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.28), inset 0 -2px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.28), 0 6px 18px -6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5); text-shadow: var(--plate-shadow, none); } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--brass-light, #eef2f8); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Award Row
components.description: One team's award controls in the answer phase: rimmed chip with green plus and red minus numeral buttons.
components.html: Lag 1400
components.css: .ds-award { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 6px; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--brass, #cfd7e6) 50%, transparent); border-radius: 6px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--stage-floor, #121c31) 70%, transparent); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, var(--brass-light, #eef2f8) 22%, transparent), inset 0 -1px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35); font-family: var(--font-ui, Jost, 'Futura', 'Avenir Next', system-ui, sans-serif); color: var(--cream, #eef2f8); } .ds-award-team { display: flex; flex: 1; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-width: 0; padding: 0 8px; font-size: 15px; } .ds-bib { display: inline-block; flex-shrink: 0; width: 12px; height: 12px; border-radius: 999px; background: radial-gradient(circle at 35% 30%, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.75), var(--bib, #f3c942) 55%, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35)); box-shadow: 0 0 12px color-mix(in srgb, var(--bib, #f3c942) 40%, transparent); } .ds-award-name { overflow: hidden; white-space: nowrap; text-overflow: ellipsis; } .ds-award-score { margin-left: auto; color: var(--cream-dim, rgba(238, 242, 248, 0.68)); font-weight: 600; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums lining-nums; } .ds-award-btn { min-height: 48px; min-width: 4.5rem; padding: 0 12px; border: 0; border-radius: 4px; font: inherit; font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 600; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums lining-nums; letter-spacing: -0.02em; cursor: pointer; user-select: none; transition: background-color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-award-plus { color: var(--bib-green, #48b97c); background: rgba(72, 185, 124, 0.22); } .ds-award-plus:hover, .ds-award-plus:active { background: rgba(72, 185, 124, 0.4); } .ds-award-minus { color: var(--bib-red, #e05252); background: rgba(224, 82, 82, 0.22); } .ds-award-minus:hover, .ds-award-minus:active { background: rgba(224, 82, 82, 0.4); } .ds-award-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--brass-light, #eef2f8); outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview:
The living room is still a quiz studio: a lit money ladder standing on a dark stage, nameplates over the columns, a row of podium plaques for the teams. What changed is that the studio is no longer built from one fixed set of materials. The world is theme-parametric. Every surface is painted through the same small set of CSS custom properties, and a board chooses which of seven lighting rigs fills them: "Midnatt og sølv" (the default: deep navy, silver plates, cool white), "Skifer og kobber", "Burgunder og krem", "Skog og dempet messing", "Lys scene" (the one light theme), "Monokrom", and "Studio" (the original brass-and-lamplight look). The user rejected the brass glow as the default because it was too much; it survives only as the "Studio" theme, and only there do panels glow.

The token vocabulary kept its studio names as roles, not hues. brass is the accent and plate material, cream is the foreground light, stage is the ground, lamp is the points readout, velvet is the one secondary field. In "Midnatt" brass is silver and cream is cool white; in "Lys scene" the stage is paper and cream is near-black ink. Code never names a hue; it names a role, and the theme decides what that role looks like. The theme is stored on the board as content.theme and applied by themeStyle() to the root element of the four board surfaces: big screen, phone remote, board preview and editor. App chrome (landing, "Nytt brett", "Koble til", the 404) uses the :root defaults, which are the "Midnatt" values.

The system still has two densities. The big screen is one full-bleed viewport with no scrolling, where every size is a clamp() of viewport width so a 5x6 board and a 3x3 board both fill a TV. Everything else is a plain, fast tool page on the same stage: same roles, same utilities, ordinary rem sizes, centred containers. Type moved from a Didone to Young Serif, a sturdy low-contrast serif with a single weight, chosen because thin hairlines died at TV distance. Questions are now set in Jost semibold, and italics are gone from the type system. Motion is unchanged: one spotlight scale-in, one envelope slide-up, one photographic develop, one plaque flash, all on one ease.
keyCharacteristics: Seven selectable themes, each a complete set of custom properties; default is "Midnatt og sølv"
Token names are semantic roles (accent, foreground, ground, panel, plate) carried over from the studio vocabulary
Plates for names and labels, panels for points, plaques for teams, in every theme
Glow is a variable and is zero in six of seven themes; only "Studio" glows
Young Serif for words read as titles, Jost 600 for numerals, controls and the question itself
Tabular lining numerals everywhere numbers appear, one ease for all motion, everything static under reduced motion

rules.name: The Roles Not Hues Rule
rules.body: A component names a role (brass, cream, stage-floor, panel-fg), never a colour. No hex, rgb or Tailwind palette colour may appear in a component or page, because it will be wrong in six of seven themes. The only exceptions are the eight bib colours and the QR code's module colours.

rules.name: The Theme Root Rule
rules.body: A theme is applied once, as inline custom properties from themeStyle() on the root element of a board surface. Nothing below the root re-declares a theme variable, and app chrome never applies a theme; it inherits the :root "Midnatt" defaults.

rules.name: The Plate Is Material Rule
rules.body: Anything that reads as a plate uses the three-stop plate gradient with its inset highlight and bottom edge; anything merely accent-edged uses the rim at 50% accent. The accent is not painted flat on a surface.

rules.name: The One Velvet Rule
rules.body: The velvet utility appears in exactly one place: the confirm-reset button. It is not a hover colour, an error colour or a decorative field.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Young Serif speaks for names and titles (board title, category, team name, answer). Jost speaks for numbers, actions and the question (points, scores, buttons, tabs, question text). No third face, no serif in a button, no Jost on a nameplate.

rules.name: The One Weight Rule
rules.body: Young Serif is loaded at 400 only. Weight utilities on display text do not change the face: font-medium renders as 400 and font-semibold or font-bold are browser-synthesised. Hierarchy in the display face comes from size and colour, not weight; treat existing weight classes on display text as inert.

rules.name: The No Italic Rule
rules.body: The display face has no italic and the type system uses none. The single remaining <em> on the landing hero renders as a synthesised slant and is emphasis by colour, not by style.

rules.name: The Tabular Numeral Rule
rules.body: Every number is set with the numeral utility or inherits the global tabular lining feature settings. Scores roll from old to new value over 700ms and must not shift width while doing so.

rules.name: The Lit-Or-Dark Rule
rules.body: A points panel is either lit (panel face, panel ink, ring) or dark (flat unlit face, faint numeral, no shadow). There is no half state; the transition between them is 300ms on the stage ease.

rules.name: The Glow Is Studio-Only Rule
rules.body: Glow is glow-size, and only "Studio" sets it above zero. No component adds its own glow; the two remaining hardcoded amber glows (overlay points halo, plaque flash) are debt to be moved onto lamp-glow.

dos: Do build every new page on the stage-spotlight background inside a min-h-dvh flex column with the site header, and apply themeStyle() on the root when the page belongs to a board.

Do colour everything through role tokens (brass, cream, stage-floor, panel-fg, plate-a) so it survives all seven themes; check a change in "Lys scene" and "Burgunder" as well as the default, since those flip panel and plate polarity.
Do paint anything named or titled on a plate in plate ink and Young Serif, and anything counted on a panel or plaque in tabular Jost 600.
Do size big-screen text with clamp() against viewport width so it survives an 8x8 board on a TV at 2 to 5 metres; clue text may reach 7.2rem.
Do keep controls at least 48px tall (tap) on any surface a host touches, and 56px for the one primary action on a view.
Do use exactly one brass button per view; every other action is outline or ghost.
Do mark state with material, not colour: lit versus unlit panels, plate versus rim for the leader and the selected theme, the green dot for a live connection.
Do show all UI copy in Norwegian bokmål with verb-first host labels.
donts: Don't hardcode a hue in a component or page, or reach for a Tailwind palette colour; the only fixed colours are the eight bibs and the QR module colours.
Don't add glow, halo or amber to a component; glow is glow-size and belongs to the "Studio" theme alone.
Don't flatten the accent into a solid fill on a plate or a tinted border; plates use the three-stop gradient and rims use the 50% accent hairline.
Don't add velvet outside the reset confirmation.
Don't add drop shadows to cards, inputs or buttons; depth comes from inset highlights and translucent floors.
Don't use italics anywhere, or rely on font-weight to differentiate display text; Young Serif has one weight and no italic.
Don't put Young Serif on a button, a numeral or the question, or Jost on a nameplate.
Don't let the big-screen board scroll, wrap category plates past two lines, or introduce a second animation ease.
Don't apply a theme anywhere but the root of a board surface, and never on app chrome.
Don't write code comments in this repository; the design is carried by tokens, utilities and this document.
